name: NV-204
indication: Advanced or unresectable melanoma with RAF pathway activation
mechanismOfAction: Selective RAF-dimer inhibition, suppressing MAPK pathway signalling in tumours that escape first-generation BRAF inhibitors.
summary: An oral RAF-dimer inhibitor designed to address the resistance mechanisms that limit existing targeted therapy in melanoma.

name: NV-118
indication: Moderate to severe plaque psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis
mechanismOfAction: Monoclonal antibody binding the p19 subunit of IL-23, blocking downstream Th17 activation while leaving IL-12 signalling intact.
summary: A selective IL-23 inhibitor approved for adults with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis, with quarterly maintenance dosing.

name: NV-330
mechanismOfAction: Small-molecule modulation of microglial TREM2 signalling, intended to restore clearance of neurotoxic protein aggregates.
summary: An investigational TREM2 modulator being evaluated for its effect on cognitive decline in early Alzheimer disease.
